gaps: eastern_zbl_08_wheeled_ifv: photos are scarce. The only close, complete views (side, side-2, three_quarter_rear, detail) show the ZBL-08A of the Hong Kong garrison (2026 open day); differences from the original ZBL-08 were not checked.
eastern_zbl_08_wheeled_ifv: the ZBL-08A photos are CC BY 4.0 as stated on Commons by a reddit photographer, without a VRT permission ticket; worth a second look before relying on them.
eastern_zbl_08_wheeled_ifv: no front, rear or top photo; no clear rear photo of the plain ZBL-08 (the Vostok rear view is distant and netted).
eastern_zbl_08_wheeled_ifv: no running-gear or sight close-up; the gap is a candidate for generated views conditioned on the side and three-quarter photos.
